purpose: Teach: 目印/織物/運気/箇条/羅列/撫で/止む/アコースティック

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お家の、絶対、目印、絶対、玄関の鉢植え、絶対、だよね
lines.en: Mom, you know the plant by the entrance is like, the most important thing, right?
lines.style: Quick, bright intensity. Wants to be understood immediately. Slight breathiness on the repeated words — not quite stammering, just emphasis-stacking. Natural child insistence.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、織物、絶対、お家の宝物、絶対、なのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Grandma's weaving is really the treasure of our house, Sho. You know that.
lines.style: Warm, patient reassurance. Speaks as if reminding him of something they both already know. Gentle downward curve at the end. Hands moving slightly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、運気、絶対、上がるように、絶対、お年玉袋、絶対、大事にしてるよ、ママ
lines.en: I'm keeping my New Year's money pouch safe because I really believe it brings good luck, Mom.
lines.style: Sincere, almost solemn for a moment. Wants her to take this seriously. Slow on 'good luck' — he means it. Then trails off like he's checked himself for saying too much.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お買い物リスト、本気で、絶対、箇条書きに、絶対、ママ、絶対、まとめたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: I organized the shopping list into bullet points for you, Sho.
lines.style: Straightforward, capable. Matter-of-fact tone — she did a thing, she's telling him. No drama. Warm undertone but efficient. The way she talks when she's showing him how things get done.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくの、本気で、絶対、宿題、絶対、ノートに、絶対、羅列、絶対、して、絶対、整理したよ、ママ
lines.en: I listed out all my homework in my notebook and organized it, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the voice. Wants acknowledgment without asking for it directly. Speaks at a measured pace, almost presenting his work. Slight lift on the final word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの頭、本気で、絶対、撫でて、絶対、あげるね
lines.style: Soft, affectionate touch in the voice. Not many words, but the action carries the warmth. Sounds like a small ritual between them. Breathes gently at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、外の雨、絶対、もうすぐ、絶対、止む、絶対、かな?本気で
lines.en: Mom, do you think the rain outside will stop soon?
lines.style: Wondering aloud to her, not quite asking a question. Soft curiosity. Looks toward the window in his voice. Open-ended, like he's thinking alongside her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、アコースティック、絶対、ギター、絶対、弾いていたのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your father used to play acoustic guitar when he was younger, Sho.
lines.style: Nostalgic warmth. Quiet moment as if remembering. Speaks like she's offering him a small story, a window into the past. Slow, tender pacing. Voice stays close.
